# edge-slugs Specification

## Purpose

Exercise the D5 slug derivation and byte-stability rules over requirement and
scenario names with punctuation runs, digits, casing, and separators.

## Requirements

### Requirement:   --Leading & Trailing punctuation!!
<!-- slug: leading-trailing-punctuation -->

The projection MUST derive a clean kebab-slug even when the name carries
leading, trailing, and interior punctuation runs.

#### Scenario: Mixed CASE and   multiple   spaces
<!-- slug: mixed-case-and-multiple-spaces -->

- **GIVEN** a name with mixed casing and repeated spaces
- **WHEN** the slug is derived
- **THEN** the slug is lowercased with single-dash separators

### Requirement: Digits 123 and codes v2.0
<!-- slug: digits-123-and-codes-v2-0 -->

The slug MUST preserve digit runs while collapsing surrounding
punctuation, per D5. This requirement MUST hold.

#### Scenario: already-kebab-case
<!-- slug: already-kebab-case -->

- **GIVEN** a name that is already kebab-case
- **WHEN** the slug is derived
- **THEN** the slug is unchanged
